original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Surface Plasmon: Surface Plasmon Resonance. SPR experiments were conducted on a BIACORE T100 using Biacore CMS series S sensor chips (GE Life Sciences). Briefly, polyclonal anti-GST antibody (Abcam, Cambridge) was immobilized on all flow cells via amine coupling with capture levels between 2280 RU and 6700 RU (GE Life Sciences GST capture kit). As a control, GST alone was captured on the reference flow cell (between 520 RU and 1280 RU) and the GST tagged proteins were immobilized on the active flow cells (between 690 RU and 1990 RU). Lyophilized peptides (in triplicate) were resuspended in analysis buffer and injected over all four flow cells at 30 μL·min⁻¹ for 60–80 s. The +PO₄³⁻ buffer consisted of 50 mM Na₂PO₄, 150–300 mM NaCl, and 1 mM DTT (pH 7.4), whereas the −PO₄³⁻ buffer consisted of 1 mM Na₃PO₄ (reflecting a physiological concentration), 150 mM NaCl, 20 mM Tris, 1 mM DTT (pH 7.4). Peptide 3 required regeneration with 2 M NaCl before injection of the next peptide cycle. Data were analyzed using Scrubber2.0 (BioLogic Software, Campbell, ACT, Australia) and Prism 6.0 (GraphPad Software, California, USA).
